comment:
* Observer for network type changes. * *

{@link #register Registered} listeners are informed at registration and whenever the network * type changes. * *

The current network type can also be {@link #getNetworkType queried} without registration.

variables.name: listeners
variables.comment: This class needs to hold weak references as it doesn't require listeners to unregister.

   * @param context A {@link Context}.
